Troubleshoot connectivity, VLAN, routing, switching and network performance issues. Support network changes, upgrades, equipment replacement and maintenance activities. Network migration, technology refresh or large-scale rollout projects. review_candidates.description: Role Mission: The SaaS Technical Lead will lead the operational ownership, governance, reliability, and continuous improvement of the company’s shared enterprise software platforms such as PDPA, Marketing Communication, Workload Management, Address Manager, Knowledge Management and Splunk products which are operated under Starhub’s telecommunication business. This role ensures these mission-critical SaaS and enterprise platforms operate securely, reliably, and in compliance with regulatory requirements while enabling business and engineering teams to function efficiently. The SaaS Technical Lead embeds operational excellence, automation, observability, security, compliance, and cost governance into all enterprise software platforms. The role also supports legacy system modernization initiatives, including migration from On-Premise environments to AWS Cloud. Accountabilities: Lead and mentor junior SaaS/platform engineers in supporting enterprise software platforms. Own day-2 operations including availability, reliability, patching, upgrades, configuration management, and vendor escalations. Establish and enforce governance standards across enterprise SaaS platforms (access control, security hardening, audit readiness, DR posture). Drive automation, monitoring, and operational improvements to reduce manual effort and incident rates. Lead and support legacy system migration initiatives from On-Premise infrastructure to AWS Cloud, ensuring secure, scalable, and resilient target-state architectures. Collaborate with Shared Services Manager, Platform Architect, Security, Compliance, Procurement, and Business stakeholders to align platform roadmap and operational priorities. Responsibilities: Own, operate, and maintain all shared enterprise software platforms under Shared Services governance, Ensure high availability and reliability of platforms through proactive monitoring, capacity planning, performance tuning, and SLA management. Support and execute migration of legacy enterprise systems from On-Premise infrastructure to AWS Cloud, including architecture review, migration planning, security hardening, data migration, performance validation, and post-migration stabilization. Support observability platform administration and integrations with other applications and tools (e.g., Splunk, Dynatrace). Define and maintain RBAC models, audit trails, security controls, and compliance standards aligned with CSA best practices and MAS-TRM guidelines. Manage vendor relationships including support contracts, license renewals, escalation handling, performance reviews, and roadmap alignment. Lead major version upgrades, platform migrations, DR testing, patch cycles, and vulnerability remediation programs. Support incident response, problem management, root cause analysis (RCA), CAB reviews and continuous service improvement initiatives. Maintain comprehensive platform documentation including architecture diagrams, operational runbooks, DR procedures, support playbooks, and knowledge base articles. Track license utilization, SaaS consumption trends, and cost optimization opportunities to improve financial governance and resource efficiency. Team Scope / Stakeholders: Leads a small team of SaaS/platform support engineers. Key stakeholders include: Shared Services Manager Platform Engineers Application & DevOps Teams IT Operations & SRE Security & Compliance Marketing & Business Operations Teams Procurement & Vendor Management Minimum Profile / Track Record: Desired Background Experience in medium-to-large enterprises or financial services environments managing multiple mission-critical enterprise software platforms. Exposure to regulated environments requiring strong governance, auditability, and compliance controls. Experience supporting both SaaS and on-prem enterprise systems with hybrid or cloud migration initiatives. Seniority, Skills, Certifications (must-haves) 8+ years of experience in enterprise platform engineering, SaaS operations, or IT infrastructure engineering. Strong experience managing enterprise SaaS platforms and/or on-prem enterprise applications. Hands-on expertise in: Access control and RBAC governance ITIL processes (Incident, Problem, Change, Release) Monitoring & observability tools (Splunk, Dynatrace, or equivalent) Automation scripting (Any of Python, Bash, PowerShell) Public Cloud fundamentals (EC2, RDS, IAM, VPC, backup & DR patterns) Experience managing vendor escalations and enterprise software contracts. Sound knowledge in security and compliance standards (MAS-TRM, CSA). ITIL certification, AWS/Azure certifications, or vendor-specific certifications are a plus. Ideal Track Record: Successfully operated and stabilized multiple enterprise SaaS platforms with measurable improvements in uptime, MTTR, operational maturity, and service quality. Led major platform upgrades, migrations, or modernization initiatives with minimal business disruption. Led or mentored a team of 2–5 engineers and drove governance standardization across multiple enterprise software platforms.

review_candidates.title: I O Engineering Consultant - DevOps Azure
review_candidates.description: Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start Caring. Connecting. Growing together. Primary Responsibilities Build and maintain Azure resources using modern Infrastructure-as-Code tooling (Terraform, Ansible) Build and maintain pipelines and automation through GitOps (GitHub Actions, JPAC, etc.) Create and own platform level services on top of Kubernetes (AKS, Azure Container Apps) Develop automation scripts by submitting PRs and participating in code reviews (Github) Use AI tools like GitHub Copilot and ChatGPT to enhance productivity, automation, and code quality Learn and apply new AI tools and techniques to improve development workflows and solutions Stay up-to-date with the latest advancements in AI and integrate them into daily tasks and projects Build monitoring and alerting templates for various cloud metrics (Splunk, Dynatrace, Azure app insights) Participate in a shared on-call rotation Works with less structured, more complex issues Analyzes and investigates Provides explanations and interpretations within area of expertise Comply with the terms and conditions of the employment contract, company policies and procedures, and any and all directives (such as, but not limited to, transfer and/or re-assignment to different work locations, change in teams and/or work shifts, policies in regards to flexibility of work benefits and/or work environment, alternative work arrangements, and other decisions that may arise due to the changing business environment). The Company may adopt, vary or rescind these policies and directives in its absolute discretion and without any limitation (implied or otherwise) on its ability to do so Required Qualifications Graduate degree or equivalent experience 5+ years of experience defining, designing, and implementing CI/CD systems (such as GitHub Actions, Jenkins, etc.) 3+ years of experience building and troubleshooting cloud networks 2+ years of experience with Terraform Experience with Monitoring tools such as Dynatrace, Splunk, Grafana, and Prometheus Experience with AI tools and integration (like ChatGPT, M365 Copilot GitHub Copilot, etc.) Experience with advanced scripting Knowledge of AI model integration into applications Solid knowledge of Azure networking, such as configuring virtual networks, firewalls, load balancers, and VPNs Expertise in identifying and mitigating infrastructure security vulnerabilities Expertise in managing cost optimized infrastructure setups Expertise in setting monitors, triggers, alerts and managing the infra setup on highest availability and reliability standards Proven team player attitude and willingness to collaborate with others At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.
